authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13734 strī means woman/wife. The unchanged Bengali consonant cluster identifies the learned Sanskrit word; Kalasha istrīźā is separately identified in the article as a modern compound with jāyā and needs both parts represented. Exact survey form stri is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
